Kind nat type.

Kind real type.

Type r_exp real -> real.

%% === Tensor Addition ===

Define tensor_add : tensor -> tensor -> tensor -> prop by
  tensor_add t_empty t_empty t_empty ;
  tensor_add (t_cons M N T1) (t_cons M N T2) (t_cons M N T3) :=
    tensor_add T1 T2 T3.

%% === Matrix Multiplication ===

Define tensor_mul : tensor -> tensor -> tensor -> prop by
  tensor_mul t_empty t_empty t_empty ;
  tensor_mul (t_cons M N T1) (t_cons N P T2) (t_cons M P T3) :=
    tensor_mul T1 T2 T3.

%% === Softmax ===

Define softmax : tensor -> tensor -> prop by
  softmax t_empty t_empty ;
  softmax (t_cons M N T) (t_cons M N T') :=
    softmax T T'.

%% === Structure Definition ===

Kind structure type.
Type struct tensor -> structure.

%% === FAPE Loss ===

Define fape_loss : structure -> structure -> real -> prop by
  fape_loss (struct T1) (struct T2) Loss.

%% === THEOREM 1: Tensor Addition Commutativity ===

Theorem tensor_add_comm : forall T1 T2 T3,
  tensor_add T1 T2 T3 -> tensor_add T2 T1 T3.
induction on 1. intros. case H1.
  search.
  apply IH to H2. search.

%% === THEOREM 2: Tensor Addition Associativity ===

Theorem tensor_add_assoc : forall T1 T2 T3 T12 T23 T123,
  tensor_add T1 T2 T12 ->
  tensor_add T2 T3 T23 ->
  tensor_add T12 T3 T123 ->
  exists T123', tensor_add T1 T23 T123' /\ T123 = T123'.
induction on 1. intros. case H1.
  case H2. case H3. search.
  case H2. case H3.
    apply IH to H4 H6 H8.
    search.

%% === THEOREM 3: Matrix Multiplication Associativity ===

Theorem tensor_mul_assoc : forall A B C AB BC ABC,
  tensor_mul A B AB ->
  tensor_mul B C BC ->
  tensor_mul AB C ABC ->
  exists ABC', tensor_mul A BC ABC' /\ ABC = ABC'.
induction on 1. intros. case H1.
  case H2. case H3. search.
  case H2. case H3.
    apply IH to H4 H6 H8.
    search.

%% === THEOREM 4: Softmax Preserves Structure ===

Theorem softmax_preserves : forall T T',
  softmax T T' ->
  exists M N, T = t_cons M N _ /\ T' = t_cons M N _.
induction on 1. intros. case H1.
  search.
  apply IH to H2.
    search.

%% === THEOREM 5: FAPE Loss Existence ===

Theorem fape_loss_exists : forall S1 S2,
  exists Loss, fape_loss S1 S2 Loss.
intros. case S1. case S2.
  search.

%% === THEOREM 6: FAPE Loss Uniqueness ===

Theorem fape_loss_unique : forall S1 S2 L1 L2,
  fape_loss S1 S2 L1 ->
  fape_loss S1 S2 L2 ->
  L1 = L2.
intros. case H1. case H2.
  search.

%% === THEOREM 7: Tensor Add Zero Identity ===

Define tensor_zero : tensor -> prop by
  tensor_zero t_empty ;
  tensor_zero (t_cons M N T) := tensor_zero T.

Theorem tensor_add_zero : forall T,
  tensor_zero T -> tensor_add T T T.
induction on 1. intros. case H1.
  search.
  apply IH to H2. search.

%% === THEOREM 8: Softmax Input-Output Correspondence ===

Theorem softmax_deterministic : forall T T1 T2,
  softmax T T1 ->
  softmax T T2 ->
  T1 = T2.
induction on 1. intros. case H1.
  case H2. search.
  case H2.
    apply IH to H3 H4.
    search.

%% 8. softmax_deterministic     - Softmax is deterministic ✓

entries.answer:
- **FAPE loss definíció üres/hiányos**: A `fape_loss (struct T1) (struct T2) Loss.` nem tartalmaz implementációt - nincs szabály ami meghatározná hogy Loss hogyan számítódik ki T1 és T2 alapján
- **Softmax definíció triviális**: A softmax csak azonosságként működik, nem implementál semmilyen tényleges transzformációt vagy normalizálást
- **tensor_add_assoc és tensor_mul_assoc tételek logikailag hibásak**: A `T123 = T123'` állítás redundáns - azt mondja létezik T123' ami egyenlő T123-mal, ami triviálisan igaz minden T123-ra
- **Real típus használaton**: Az r_zero, r_one, r_add, r_mul, r_exp típusok definiálva vannak de sehol nem használódnak a kódban
- **tensor_add_zero tétel félrevezető**: A tétel `tensor_add T T T` állítja (azaz T+T=T), de ez csak zero tensorra igaz; a név szerint identity property-t kellene bizonyítania (T+0=T)
- **Module direktíva nem létezik Abella-ban**: Az első sor `Module alphafold3.` nem valid Abella szintaxis
- **softmax_preserves tételben wildcard használat**: A `T = t_cons M N _` formában lévő `_` (underscore) szintaxis Abella-ban csak az apply taktikában használható placeholder-ként, nem pedig pattern matching-ben
- **Tensor műveletek nem implementáltak**: A tensor_add és tensor_mul definíciók nem tartalmaznak tényleges matematikai műveleteket, csak strukturális egyezést ellenőriznek
- **FAPE loss tételek triviálisak**: Mivel a fape_loss definíció lényegében üres (bármely Loss-ra igaz), a fape_loss_exists és fape_loss_unique tételek bizonyításai értelmetlenek
- **Hiányzó Kind/Type exportok**: Az Abella-ban nincs explicit module system ahogy a kód használja
- **Comments nem támogatottak %% jellel**: Abella csak `%` egysoros és `/* */` többsoros kommenteket támogat, a `%%` nem valid

entries.query:
osszes hibat keresd meg válaszodban szeretném ha csak listába írnád írnád a dolgokat amiket keresek, minden más nélkül. 
; AlphaFold 3 Formal Verification in ACL2
; Termination Proofs + Inductive Reasoning
; NO PLACEHOLDERS - Complete ACL2 Implementation

(in-package "ACL2")

;;; === List-based Tensor Representation ===

(defun tensorp (m n x)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (natp m) (natp n))))
  (and (true-listp x)
       (equal (len x) m)
       (all-rows-length-n n x)))

(defun all-rows-length-n (n rows)
  (declare (xargs :guard (natp n)))
  (if (endp rows)
      t
    (and (true-listp (car rows))
         (equal (len (car rows)) n)
         (all-rows-length-n n (cdr rows)))))

;;; === Tensor Addition ===

(defun add-vectors (v1 v2)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (rational-listp v1)
                              (rational-listp v2)
                              (equal (len v1) (len v2)))))
  (if (endp v1)
      nil
    (cons (+ (car v1) (car v2))
          (add-vectors (cdr v1) (cdr v2)))))

(defun tensor-add (t1 t2)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (true-listp t1)
                              (true-listp t2)
                              (equal (len t1) (len t2)))))
  (if (endp t1)
      nil
    (cons (add-vectors (car t1) (car t2))
          (tensor-add (cdr t1) (cdr t2)))))

;;; === Tensor Addition Properties ===

(defthm tensor-add-commutative
  (implies (and (tensorp m n t1)
                (tensorp m n t2))
           (equal (tensor-add t1 t2)
                  (tensor-add t2 t1)))
  :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable tensorp tensor-add add-vectors))))

(defthm tensor-add-associative
  (implies (and (tensorp m n t1)
                (tensorp m n t2)
                (tensorp m n t3))
           (equal (tensor-add t1 (tensor-add t2 t3))
                  (tensor-add (tensor-add t1 t2) t3)))
  :hints (("Goal" :induct (tensor-add t1 t2))))

;;; === Dot Product ===

(defun dot-product (v1 v2)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (rational-listp v1)
                              (rational-listp v2)
                              (equal (len v1) (len v2)))))
  (if (endp v1)
      0
    (+ (* (car v1) (car v2))
       (dot-product (cdr v1) (cdr v2)))))

(defthm dot-product-commutative
  (equal (dot-product v1 v2)
         (dot-product v2 v1))
  :hints (("Goal" :induct (dot-product v1 v2))))

(defthm dot-product-distributive
  (implies (and (rational-listp v1)
                (rational-listp v2)
                (rational-listp v3)
                (equal (len v1) (len v2))
                (equal (len v2) (len v3)))
           (equal (dot-product v1 (add-vectors v2 v3))
                  (+ (dot-product v1 v2)
                     (dot-product v1 v3))))
  :hints (("Goal" :induct (add-vectors v2 v3))))

;;; === Matrix Transpose ===

(defun get-column (mat j)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (true-listp mat) (natp j))))
  (if (endp mat)
      nil
    (cons (nth j (car mat))
          (get-column (cdr mat) j))))

(defun transpose-helper (mat n i)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (true-listp mat) (natp n) (natp i))
                  :measure (nfix (- n i))))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (not (natp i))
          (>= i n))
      nil
    (cons (get-column mat i)
          (transpose-helper mat n (1+ i)))))

(defun transpose (mat n)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (true-listp mat) (natp n))))
  (transpose-helper mat n 0))

;;; === Matrix Multiplication ===

(defun matrix-mul-row (row mat)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (rational-listp row) (true-listp mat))))
  (if (endp mat)
      nil
    (cons (dot-product row (car mat))
          (matrix-mul-row row (cdr mat)))))

(defun matrix-mul (m1 m2t)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (true-listp m1) (true-listp m2t))))
  (if (endp m1)
      nil
    (cons (matrix-mul-row (car m1) m2t)
          (matrix-mul (cdr m1) m2t))))

(defthm matrix-mul-preserves-dimensions
  (implies (and (tensorp m n t1)
                (tensorp n p t2))
           (tensorp m p (matrix-mul t1 (transpose t2 p))))
  :hints (("Goal" :induct (matrix-mul t1 t2))))

;;; === Softmax (Simplified) ===

(defun exp-approx (x)
  (declare (xargs :guard (rationalp x)))
  ; Approximation: exp(x) ≈ 1 + x + x²/2 + x³/6
  (+ 1 x (/ (* x x) 2) (/ (* x x x) 6)))

(defun list-max (lst)
  (declare (xargs :guard (rational-listp lst)))
  (if (endp lst)
      0
    (if (endp (cdr lst))
        (car lst)
      (max (car lst) (list-max (cdr lst))))))

(defun shift-vector (v max-val)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (rational-listp v) (rationalp max-val))))
  (if (endp v)
      nil
    (cons (- (car v) max-val)
          (shift-vector (cdr v) max-val))))

(defun exp-vector (v)
  (declare (xargs :guard (rational-listp v)))
  (if (endp v)
      nil
    (cons (exp-approx (car v))
          (exp-vector (cdr v)))))

(defun sum-list (lst)
  (declare (xargs :guard (rational-listp lst)))
  (if (endp lst)
      0
    (+ (car lst) (sum-list (cdr lst)))))

(defun divide-vector (v divisor)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (rational-listp v)
                              (rationalp divisor)
                              (not (equal divisor 0)))))
  (if (endp v)
      nil
    (cons (/ (car v) divisor)
          (divide-vector (cdr v) divisor))))

(defun softmax (v)
  (declare (xargs :guard (rational-listp v)))
  (let* ((max-v (list-max v))
         (shifted (shift-vector v max-v))
         (exps (exp-vector shifted))
         (sum-exp (sum-list exps)))
    (if (equal sum-exp 0)
        v  ; Fallback
      (divide-vector exps sum-exp))))

(defthm softmax-length-preserved
  (implies (rational-listp v)
           (equal (len (softmax v)) (len v)))
  :hints (("Goal" :induct (softmax v))))

;;; === FAPE Loss Function ===

(defun square (x)
  (declare (xargs :guard (rationalp x)))
  (* x x))

(defun euclidean-dist-sq (p1 p2)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (rational-listp p1)
                              (rational-listp p2)
                              (equal (len p1) 3)
                              (equal (len p2) 3))))
  (+ (square (- (nth 0 p1) (nth 0 p2)))
     (square (- (nth 1 p1) (nth 1 p2)))
     (square (- (nth 2 p1) (nth 2 p2)))))

(defun clamp-distance (d)
  (declare (xargs :guard (rationalp d)))
  (if (> d 10) 10 d))

(defun fape-errors (pred-coords truth-coords)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (true-listp pred-coords)
                              (true-listp truth-coords)
                              (equal (len pred-coords) (len truth-coords)))))
  (if (endp pred-coords)
      nil
    (cons (clamp-distance (euclidean-dist-sq (car pred-coords) (car truth-coords)))
          (fape-errors (cdr pred-coords) (cdr truth-coords)))))

(defun fape-loss (pred-coords truth-coords)
  (declare (xargs :guard (and (true-listp pred-coords)
                              (true-listp truth-coords)
                              (equal (len pred-coords) (len truth-coords)))))
  (let ((errors (fape-errors pred-coords truth-coords))
        (n (len pred-coords)))
    (if (equal n 0)
        0
      (/ (sum-list errors) n))))

;;; === FAPE Properties ===

(defthm fape-loss-nonnegative
  (implies (and (true-listp pred)
                (true-listp truth)
                (equal (len pred) (len truth)))
           (>= (fape-loss pred truth) 0))
  :hints (("Goal" :induct (fape-errors pred truth))))

(defthm fape-loss-bounded
  (implies (and (true-listp pred)
                (true-listp truth)
                (equal (len pred) (len truth)))
           (<= (fape-loss pred truth) 10))
  :hints (("Goal" :induct (fape-errors pred truth))))

;;; === VERIFICATION SUMMARY ===

; PROVEN THEOREMS IN ACL2:
; ========================
; 1. tensor-add-commutative        - Tensor addition commutes ✓
; 2. tensor-add-associative        - Tensor addition associates ✓
; 3. dot-product-commutative       - Dot product commutes ✓
; 4. dot-product-distributive      - Dot product distributes ✓
; 5. matrix-mul-preserves-dimensions - Matrix mul preserves dims ✓
; 6. softmax-length-preserved      - Softmax preserves length ✓
; 7. fape-loss-nonnegative         - FAPE loss ≥ 0 ✓
; 8. fape-loss-bounded             - FAPE loss ≤ 10 ✓
;
; All theorems proven with TERMINATION PROOFS.
; NO PLACEHOLDERS - Complete ACL2 implementation.
; Verification command: (ld "alphafold3.lisp")
entries.answer:
- in-package parancs nem része az ACL2 logikának és használata érvénytelen   
- rational-listp predikátum nincs beépítve, nincs definiálva   
- len függvény nem ACL2 beépített függvénye, használata hibás   
- dot-product-commutative tétel nem tartalmazza a v1, v2 hosszára vonatkozó előfeltételeket   
- :induct hint szintaxisa helytelen (pl. (softmax v), (tensor-add t1 t2) nem megfelelő)   
- matrix-mul-preserves-dimensions tételben t2 változó nem létezik, m2t név helytelen utalása   
- A legtöbb rekurzív defun hiányzik a befejező mérő (:measure) a termináció bizonyításához

- A záró zárójel hiányzik: 7295 nyitó `(` és 7294 záró `)`[1]
- Hiányzó `end` blokkvégződések: 1976 blokkindító (function/module/struct/begin/if/for/while/macro) vs. 1917 `end` → 59 hiányzó `end`[1]

- 1 hiányzó záró `)`  
- 59 hiányzó `end` blokkzáró  
- 1 hiányzó dupla idézőjel
